title: Lean statements from published papers
description: Nine independent Lean problem files containing 18 theorem statements from the published a3-gsw-classification, gsw-ray-periodicity and heesch-certificates repositories. Definitions, namespaces, hypotheses and theorem types are preserved. The theorem bodies intentionally use by sorry; formal_proof attributes link to the corresponding public proofs at fixed commits. Source reconstruction, theorem-type correspondence and parsed metadata have been checked. Elaborating these statements does not establish their truth or execute the linked proofs. The package is not an official part of formal-conjectures and has not been contributed to it. It includes its own checking tools and two unmodified Apache-2.0 attribute modules from the Formal Conjectures Authors.
